messages.subject: Name data points in scatter plot
messages.subject_clean: Name data points in scatter plot
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Is it possible in Deducer  to name data points in scatter plots ? My data points are countries and I would like to name some (for instance, outliers) or all of them by their case name which is a 2 character country code ? And if so, how ?

TIA
-ftr

messages.subject: Re: Name data points in scatter plot
messages.subject_clean: Name data points in scatter plot
messages.body_plain:
Hi, assuming that you have the names coded in another country of the
data frame, you can use the "text" geom to print them. If you use the
same x and y coordinates as for the scatter plot, the names will
probably overlap the points, which may be disturbing. You can,
however, configure the options of that geom to choose another baseline
and entry points for the text boxes. Or you can force the position of
the labels in a fixed distance  from the x and y coordinates.

If you want only print the names of e.g. the outliers, there may be
different solutions. The one that I can think first is create a new
column, with the original country name for outliers, and an empty
value in other cases. Then use that column for the text geom.

Helios.
